question: 一共有多少个客户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: 客户分布在哪些城市？
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers

question: 2025 年 3 月一共有多少笔订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-03-01' AND order_date <= '2025-03-31'

question: 订单状态有哪几种？
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders

question: 每个城市的客户数量分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city

question: 按销售额（数量 × 单价）排名前 5 的商品名称和销售额分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS amount FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY amount DESC, p.name ASC LIMIT 5

question: 每个商品品类的平均售价分别是多少？（保留 2 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: 消费金额最高的前 10 位客户姓名是什么？（只统计已完成的订单，金额按数量 × 单价计算）
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 10

question: 2025 年每个月的订单数量分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY month

question: 退款金额最高的 3 笔退款，对应的订单号和金额是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, amount FROM refunds ORDER BY amount DESC, order_id ASC LIMIT 3

question: 有多少笔订单从未支付过？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM payments)

question: 买过“手机”类商品的客户姓名有哪些？（去重）
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = '手机'

question: 平均每笔订单包含多少件商品？（保留 2 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(qty), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: 使用“微信支付”的订单一共有多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE method = '微信支付'

question: 2025 年第二季度的总销售额是多少？（只统计已完成订单，金额按数量 × 单价计算，保留 2 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30'

question: 从未下过订单的客户有多少位？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: 每个客户等级的平均订单金额分别是多少？（只统计已完成订单，保留 2 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.order_id) t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.level

question: 销售额最高的前 3 个城市是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY amount DESC, c.city ASC LIMIT 3

question: 下单次数超过 10 次的客户姓名和下单次数分别是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

question: 平均每笔退款金额是多少？（保留 2 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) FROM refunds

question: 每个下单渠道的订单数占比分别是多少？（百分比，保留 1 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 1) FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: 价格高于 5000 元的商品有多少件？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 5000

question: 退款总金额占已完成订单销售额的百分比是多少？（保留 2 位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM refunds) / (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'), 2)

question: 商品数量最多的品类是哪个？有多少件商品？
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY cnt DESC, category ASC LIMIT 1
